Khushboo Chahar

Professional Summary Data Governance and Management professional with 5.9 years of experience driving data governance, data quality, metadata management, data lineage, and regulatory compliance initiatives across banking and enterprise environments. Experienced in implementing governance frameworks, activating Critical Data Elements (CDEs), supporting GDPR-aligned data classification and lifecycle management, and partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to strengthen data-driven decision- making and risk management.

Employment History American Express Data Governance & Management Analyst

Aug 2024 - June 2026

Governance & Program Leadership

Collaborated with business stakeholders, data owners, and technology teams to identify

systems of record, critical data elements, and source application dependencies for enterprise data governance initiatives.

Supported source-to-target mapping activities by documenting source system attributes,

business definitions, transformation logic, and downstream reporting requirements.

Maintained metadata, lineage, and traceability documentation within governance platforms,

enabling transparency across data flows and supporting audit and compliance requirements.

Partnered with data engineering and product teams to validate data requirements, resolve data definition discrepancies, and ensure alignment between business and technical specifications.

Coordinated data readiness activities, including test data identification, data validation support, and stakeholder sign-offs, enabling parallel development and testing activities.

Developed and maintained governance artefacts including business glossaries, data

dictionaries, lineage records, data quality inventories, and evidence documentation packs.

Facilitated governance reviews and change management processes to ensure data

requirements, mappings, and lineage records remained current and compliant with organizational standards.

Risk & Escalation Management

Conducted Risk & Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) in collaboration with Control Management,

strengthening control clarity and risk visibility.

Drove resolution of cross-functional escalation issues, aligning with impacted Directors and

reducing activation delays

Process Ownership & Transformation

Designed and standardized SOPs for Data Catalog Assessment process, improving documentation

integrity and review discipline. Implemented Airtable-based intake automation and workflow enhancements, improving operational efficiency and reducing manual follow-ups.

Presented process enhancements and operational efficiency opportunities in governance forums including micro-learning series prototype, operational efficiency work allocation, Excel based dashboard for Data catalog review request.

Capgemini

Associate Consultant

Sept 2021 - July 2024

HSBC – UK & AMEA Regulatory Reporting (DUSE-3 Data Discovery)

Executed end-to-end Data Discovery for IRR-PRA and IRR-ASP prioritized ~1000 CDEs under DUSE

framework.

Performed lineage documentation, metadata management, and regulatory traceability in

Collibra by performing data tagging, stitching.

Partnered with Data Owners, Process Owners, and IT to discover Data Quality controls, providing

visibility to data-related risks to leadership.

Appointed to manage & provide updates for team of 6 analysts via JIRA, improving POD

productivity by 20% to team lead.

Securitas – Global Data Governance Programs (2 Projects)

Conducted current-state data governance assessment and contributed to drafting policies and

standards later adopted globally for Data privacy and security and Data sharing globally. Authored BRDs and technical specifications to support structured governance implementation. Created Collibra Marketplace and supported the decommissioning of data warehouse and

adoption of data lake with the drafting medallion structure for data access control.

Supported GDPR compliance efforts by classifying customer data assets, defining retention and deletion schedules, recommending data handling controls, and documenting privacy requirements for enterprise data governance implementation.
